title: Unit Release, Duplicate Overlap and Appeal Track Settings for Referrals and Authorizations
content:
These per-type settings of **Referrals and Authorizations** record whether the end of an authorization releases its unused units, which overlapping authorizations count as duplicates, and the appeal tier under which a clinical denial is reconsidered.

| Authorization type | Cancelling releases the unused units | Expiry releases the unused units | Overlapping authorizations that count as duplicates | Appeal tier for a clinical denial | Expedited track available |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | no |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | no |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | no |
| Home Health Care Authorization | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | no |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | yes | yes | same type, same patient, same servicing provider, overlapping validity spans | Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes |

## Points of reading

- A clinical denial of any type is reconsidered as a Medical Necessity Reconsideration; the expedited track (Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration) is available only for the Home Health Care, Skilled Nursing Facility and Inpatient Mental Health Authorizations.
- All four parts of the duplicate setting must hold together: an authorization of another type, for another patient, with another servicing provider, or with a span that does not overlap is not a duplicate under this setting.
